_comment: Programme detail researched from official awarding-body sources and applied by the programme_details stage. Only empty record fields are filled; a value already present is never overwritten here.
_rules: Every record must carry verification.source_citations, or the stage skips it entirely. An amount with nothing to check it against is worse than no amount, because it looks researched.
fully_funded is applied only when tuition_coverage is true, so a stipend can never be recorded as though it were a tuition waiver.
Official facts live in official_details; guidance derived from them lives in applicant_utility. They are stored apart and must never be merged.
A field the awarding body does not publish stays null. Absence of evidence is an answer, not a gap to be filled by inference.
deadline_central is the programme's own closing date. deadline_institutional is any earlier university date, stored separately.
